children: Management will host a live conference call on Tuesday, November 24, 2026 to discuss financial results and guidance.
Ottawa, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Enablence Technologies Inc.

("Enablence" or the "Company"), a leading supplier of planar lightwave circuit (PLC) optical chips for datacom, telecommunications, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced vision applications, today announced it will host a conference call and release financial results for its first quarter of fiscal 2027 ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Tuesday, November 24, 2026.
Management will host a live conference call that day at 2:00 pm PT / 5:00 pm ET to discuss the company's results and guidance.
A live webcast of the conference call can be accessed from the company's investor relations website at
. Following the call, a replay of the webcast will also be available on the investor relations website.
Enablence is a publicly traded company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange

that designs, markets and sells optical chips and sub systems, primarily in the form of planar lightwave circuits (PLC), on silicon-based chips for datacom, telecom, automotive and artificial intelligence (AI) applications. Enablence products serve a global customer base, primarily focused today on data center and other rapidly growing end markets. Enablence also works with customers that have emerging market uses for its technology, including medical devices, automotive LiDAR, and virtual and augmented reality headsets. In select strategic circumstances, the Company also uses its proprietary, non-captive fabrication plant in Fremont, California to manufacture chips designed by third party customers. For more information, visit:
Steve Cohn, CFO Enablence Technologies Inc.
Todd Haugen, CEO Enablence Technologies Inc.
